mapper.sql: FROM ha_session s JOIN ha_session c ON c.owner_key=#{owner} AND c.session_id=#{current} JOIN ha_conversation_history h ON h.owner_key=s.owner_key AND h.session_id=s.session_id WHERE s.owner_key=c.owner_key AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND (s.project_id=c.project_id OR (s.project_id IS NULL AND c.project_id IS NULL)) AND (s.agent_key=c.agent_key OR (s.agent_key IS NULL AND c.agent_key IS NULL))
mapper.select:
SELECT s.session_id,s.title,h.turn_id,h.record_id,h.message_sequence,h.created_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.payload_json,'$.role')) AS message_role, SUBSTRING(,,#{contentLimit}) AS excerpt, (-1) AS content_offset, CHAR_LENGTH() AS content_length
ORDER BY h.created_at DESC,h.history_sequence DESCORDER BY h.message_sequence,h.history_sequence LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
